roles.title: Roles
roles.searchPlaceholder: Search roles by name, slug, or description...
roles.noRolesYetHint: Get started by creating your first custom role.

form.createDescription: Create a new role with specific permissions. You can assign this role to users to control their access.
form.editDescription: Update role details and permissions. Changes will apply to all users with this role.
form.nameHint: Latin letters, digits, spaces and hyphens. {min} to {max} characters.
form.nameCharacters: Use Latin letters, digits, spaces and hyphens only
form.nameCodeTooShort: The code made from this name is too short. Add letters or digits.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Brief description of what this role can do
form.permissionsError: At least one permission is required
form.baseRoleAlert: User and Admin roles are fundamental to the system. Name and description cannot be modified, but you can update permissions.
form.protectedRoleAlert: This role cannot be deleted and its core permissions are managed by the system.
form.baseRoleNameImmutable: Base role names cannot be changed
form.protectedRoleNameImmutable: Protected role names cannot be changed
form.baseRoleDescriptionImmutable: Base role descriptions cannot be changed

detail.selectRoleHint: Select a role from the sidebar to view its details
detail.baseRoleNotice: This is a fundamental system role and cannot be edited. Only permissions can be modified for this role.
detail.protectedRoleNotice: This role cannot be deleted to preserve system integrity.

delete.title: Delete Role
delete.descriptionProtected: This role is protected and cannot be deleted.
delete.descriptionConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this role?
delete.protectedNotice: The {name} role is a system role and cannot be deleted. It is required for the application to function correctly.
delete.warningNotice: This action cannot be undone. Users with this role will need to be reassigned to another role before deletion.
